name: Using the Spaceship
pages: After the spaceship has been fueled, right click on the center of the spaceship to mount it.

pages.title: Controls
pages.text: The spaceship flies a little like creative mode and a little like a boat.  The $(k:forward)$(k:left)$(k:back)$(k:right) keys are used for direction and turning. $(k:jump) ascends, and $(k:sneak) descends. Dismount with $(k:sneak), but you will $(o)only$() dismount from the spaceship if it's on the ground.$(br2)All of these keybindings can be changed in the player keybinding settings.

pages.title: Fuel
pages.text: Fuel is not technically required to fly the spaceship, but without fuel, the spaceship will move at a very slow speed.  However, the spaceship will always descend at normal speed. (This way if you ever lose fuel in midair, you’re not… totally stranded.)

pages.title: Navigation
pages.text: To get to space, fly up in the spaceship, about 10 blocks above block build height! You will teleport to space above the planet you came from. After that, find other planets! If you approach a planet/moon with a dimension while in the spaceship, you will teleport to block build height inside said dimension.$(br)Try using a planet chart block to find the exact coordinates of each planet!

pages.title: Passengers
pages.text: Each spaceship allows two passengers, including a second player!  However, to teleport to a planet, both player passengers must be looking directly at the planet.

pages.title: Light Speed Travel
pages.text: Once you've visited a planet before, while using a spaceship in space, you will be able to use light speed travel to quickly get to that area of space again. There is a cooldown, but the more you use it, the shorter it gets.$(br2)Check it out from the spaceship inventory!

pages.title: Portals?
pages.text: Yes! You can use the stone bricks from each dimension to craft a portal.  All portals can be lit with flint and steel.
